wo-jpfa-JR4471.d:
Job Summary:

This role involves overseeing all aspects of BSL-2 (Biosafety Level 2) production operations, ensuring compliance with biosafety regulations, and optimizing production processes for animal health products.

Job Responsibilities:

* Lead and manage all BSL-2 production activities, ensuring efficient and high-quality output of animal health products.
* Develop, implement, and maintain robust biosafety protocols and procedures.
* Oversee the entire production lifecycle.
* Manage and mentor a team of production scientists and technicians, fostering a culture of safety, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure strict adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) throughout all production stages.
* Implement and monitor quality control measures for raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products, ensuring consistent product efficacy and safety.
* Collaborate with R&D, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs teams to facilitate smooth technology transfer and product registration processes.
* Manage inventory of critical raw materials, reagents, and consumables to ensure uninterrupted production schedules.
* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and maintain high-quality standards.
* Conduct regular risk assessments and implement corrective and preventative actions (CAPAs) as needed.
* Prepare and present production reports, budgets, and forecasts to senior management.
* Stay abreast of industry trends, new technologies, and regulatory changes relevant to BSL-2 production and animal health.

Job Qualifications:

* DVM (Doctor of Veterinary Medicine) or a related scientific field.
* Minimum of 1 year of progressive experience in BSL-2 production, preferably within the animal health or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Demonstrated leadership experience with at least 1 year in a managerial or supervisory role, leading production teams.
* Extensive knowledge and practical experience with BSL-2 facility operations, biosafety regulations, and containment principles.
* Proven expertise in aseptic techniques, cell culture, viral propagation, and downstream processing.
* Strong understanding of GMP and GLP regulations.
* Experience with quality management systems (e.g., ISO 9001) is highly desirable.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and team-building abilities.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Lingkup Tanggung Jawab:

• Bertanggungjawab pada produksi antigen BSL 2 sesuai target dan kualitas yang di tetapkan
• Membuat dan menyusun prosedur tetap untuk di area produksi antigen BSL2
• Mengawasi dan mengevalusi pengisian BPR dan K3
• Membuat jadwal produksi & analisa data produksi antigen BSL 2
• Melalukan pertemuan rutin dengan tim produksi antigen BSL 2
• Mengevalusi terkait sistem kerja yang lebih efektif lagi
